backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing fuel station management with tanks, sales, expenses, staff (with auto-incremented serial numbers), shifts, cash collections, price updates, Stripe payment integration, and role-based access control using Internet Identity.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that handles upgrading from old actor state (staff without serial numbers) to new actor state (staff with auto-incremented serial numbers), preserving all existing data during canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: displaying serial numbers in the staff management table and automatically assigning serial numbers when adding new staff members.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including StaffManagement.tsx which displays serial numbers in the staff table with ascending sort order and handles staff CRUD operations with manual Principal ID entry.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives and OKLCH color system variables defining light and dark theme design tokens for the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Fuel Inventory Management application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component with TanStack Router setup, authentication guard using Internet Identity, profile setup flow, auto-sync functionality, and route definitions for all dashboard pages.
frontend/src/components/AlertsPanel.tsx: Displays active and resolved tank alerts based on volume thresholds, showing tanks below threshold with refill details and links to update tank levels.
Renders visual analytics using recharts including sales trends over time, fuel type revenue/volume comparisons, and transaction counts with line and bar charts.
frontend/src/components/CashCollectionEn: Manages cash collection recording with form input, displays today's sales vs collected cash, calculates discrepancies, and shows collection history in a table.
frontend/src/components/CommissionCalcul: Calculates and displays staff commissions based on sales performance, showing breakdown by staff member with sales count, total sales, commission rate, and earned amounts.
frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard overview showing key metrics cards (active alerts, current shift, today's sales, tank status) with quick action links to various system sections.
Provides the main application layout with sidebar navigation for all routes, user profile display, admin-specific menu items, offline status indicator, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseLogger.ts: Component for logging and viewing station expenses with offline support, category-based tracking, and real-time sync status. Displays expense history in a table with category breakdowns and handles both online and offline expense recording.
frontend/src/components/FuelTypeAnalytic: Analytics dashboard comparing petrol vs diesel performance metrics including volume sold, revenue, transaction counts, and percentage breakdowns. Displays side-by-side cards with detailed statistics for each fuel type.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and error handling. Clears query cache on logout and retries login if user is already authenticated.
frontend/src/components/OfflineStatusInd: Status bar component showing connection state, pending sync items, and sync progress with manual sync trigger. Displays real-time network status, backend reachability, and provides visual feedback for sync operations.
frontend/src/components/PaymentFailure.t: Simple error page component displaying payment failure message with a return-to-dashboard button. Shows XCircle icon and user-friendly error text.
frontend/src/components/PaymentSuccess.t: Success page component confirming completed payment with a return-to-dashboard button. Displays CheckCircle icon and success message.
frontend/src/components/PriceUpdateModul: Admin-only component for updating fuel prices and viewing price history. Displays current prices for petrol/diesel and provides a form to update prices with validation and admin permission checks.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: User profile creation form collecting name, phone number, and staff role during initial setup. Full-screen centered card with validation and submission handling.
frontend/src/components/ProfitLossDashbo: Displays a financial dashboard with cards showing total revenue, expenses, net profit/loss, and profit margin calculated from sales and expenses data. Includes revenue and expense breakdowns by fuel type with visual indicators for profit/loss status.
frontend/src/components/SalesForm.tsx: Form component for recording new fuel sales with fuel type selection, quantity input, and staff assignment. Supports offline mode by saving sales locally when disconnected and syncing when connection is restored.
frontend/src/components/SalesReports.tsx: Generates sales reports with daily/weekly/monthly tabs showing total revenue, fuel-type breakdowns (petrol/diesel), volumes, and transaction counts. Displays summary cards and detailed sales tables filtered by selected time period.
Manages staff shifts with functionality to start and end shifts, displays active shift details including staff name, start time, and sales count. Shows shift history with staff selection dropdown for starting new shifts.
frontend/src/components/ShiftReport.tsx: Displays comprehensive shift reports in a table format showing shift ID, staff, timestamps, sales count, and revenue. Includes detailed fuel breakdown cards for recent shifts with petrol/diesel metrics.
React component for managing staff members with CRUD operations, role assignment, and commission rate configuration. Includes validation for Principal IDs and permission checks for admin/manager roles.
frontend/src/components/StockReconciliat: Displays daily stock reconciliation comparing opening stock, sales, and closing stock for each tank with variance analysis. Highlights discrepancies between calculated and actual closing stock levels.
frontend/src/components/TankMonitor.tsx: Component for monitoring fuel tank levels with functionality to add new tanks and update current volumes. Displays tank capacity, fuel type, and current volume with progress indicators.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication. Handles actor initialization with admin token and invalidates dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAutoSync.ts: Manages automatic synchronization of offline data when connection is restored. Triggers sync on reconnection and periodically checks for pending data to upload.
Monitors both network connectivity and backend reachability by periodically checking backend health. Tracks last online time and provides connection status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality and identity management. Creates and manages AuthClient with configurable options and tracks authentication status.
frontend/src/hooks/useOfflineStorage.ts: Manages localStorage-based offline storage for sales and expenses when backend is unreachable. Provides methods to add, clear, and retrieve pending data with count tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnlineStatus.ts: React hook that tracks browser online/offline status using navigator.onLine and window online/offline events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Comprehensive React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, tanks, sales, expenses, staff, shifts, cash collections, price updates, fuel types, expense categories, Stripe configuration, shopping items, and offline data synchronization.
frontend/src/hooks/useSyncOfflineData.ts: Hook for syncing offline sales and expenses data to the backend, tracking sync status, progress, and pending item count.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components including sidebar, charts, and semantic tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, animations, and plugin integrations for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document for Fuel Station Manager showing existing features for staff serial number display and auto-assignment, plus pending feature requests for serial number field additions.
